**Finding: ASSIGN — compliant (preferred level).**

Section 24 sits at our preferred position:

- **§ 24.1** — we may assign the Agreement or an Order Form to an Affiliate or to a merger/reorganization/acquisition/substantially-all-assets successor without Vendor consent, on prompt written notice; **§ 13.3** carries our licence rights across such a permitted assignment.
- **§ 24.2** — Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld), and may never assign to a direct Customer competitor.
- **§ 24.3** — other assignments are mutually consent-gated on a reasonableness standard.
- **§ 24.4** — our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service, so the walk-away trigger is expressly closed.

Noted but not redlined: the competitor bar is expressed as subject to our consent rather than absolute, and § 24.3's residual consent requirement is mutual — neither disadvantages us given the breadth of § 24.1. No redline proposed.
